collisionPolicy: Only new source-timed poses inside the half-open 300 ms danger interval can hit. Danger steps, pose age and pose gaps must remain at most 150 ms through final outcome settlement. A clean dodge waits for the first post-danger source sample. Motion between observations is not inferred; sufficiently fast unsampled motion can be missed.

review.iterations: Several independent review passes identified and verified source-time boundary, final-danger coverage, input-boundary, keyboard focus, contrast, layout and screenshot corrections. Final gpt-6.1-sol verdict: all ten dimensions 10/10 against the experimental single-player software criteria, with no unresolved actionable findings. The reviewer inspected source, regression tests, documentation, screenshots, report, PR and hosted CI; the root ran the serialized local checks. Physical participant/hardware certification remains unverified. The later combined-tree merge review independently re-examined readiness, camera release, stable ownership, regressions, refreshed screenshots and the updated report, and again rated all ten dimensions 10/10. The combined result is 323 Vitest tests, 54 pytest tests and 108 Dodgeball cases. Final merge is gated on the integration head’s hosted checks, not an earlier commit’s CI. A subsequent compatibility review of current main af0ac95 found no new blocker: canonical observations, session and game code stayed compatible with the shared monotonic timing and conservative identity updates. Final combined verification passed 334 Vitest tests and 96 pytest tests; all three pages built. The reviewer checked the two merge resolutions and refreshed report metadata before final merge.
